_comment: Creatures found on hunts. ALL PLACEHOLDERS for the real lore. description is shown by the look command (x). habitats: which area styles they appear in (caves, ruins, forest). tier 1-4: how dangerous; deeper and more dangerous hunts allow higher tiers. accuracy and evasion are on the same scale as the Hunter's Celerity (10 = average). damage is dice like 1d6+1. armor is subtracted from each hit taken. sight: how far away they notice you (columns; rows count double). behaviour: hunt (notices and chases you) or still (never moves; attacks anything next to it). drops: [[item id, chance, least, most], ...] left where it dies (materials; PLACEHOLDERS). injures: extra lasting injuries its big hits can cause (data/injuries.json; PLACEHOLDERS). New in v0.49.0 (the user's creatures): habitats can be a list (any time) or {style: "day"|"night"|"any"} (night = a dark place, torchlight only); styles also include mountains and plains. Optional: speed (slow: acts every other turn; quick: twice a turn), flies (can cross water), swims (lives in water; spawns there), spawn_weight (how often it's picked, x), opens (daze: dazes you when it first notices you; leap: jumps up to 3 cells to your side when you come near), burst (dice: on death, hurts everything beside it), ghost (can't hit or be hit; keeps its distance), trail (dice: the ash it leaves hurts you when you walk on it), thorns (HP you lose when your blow lands), flees (runs when its HP falls to this share), burrows (moves underground, surfaces to fight, burrows again).

cave_bat.description: A leathery flutter in the dark. Quick and hard to hit, but frail.
cave_bat.name: cave bat

pale_lurker.description: Something long and colourless that waits in the shadows.
pale_lurker.name: pale lurker

deep_horror.description: A shape the torchlight doesn't quite want to reach.
deep_horror.name: deep horror

hollow_brute.description: Huge and heavily built. It hits like a falling wall.
hollow_brute.name: hollow brute

rust_rat.description: A rat with a coat the colour of old iron. Nimble.
rust_rat.name: rust rat

scavenger.description: A hunched figure picking through the ruins for scraps.
scavenger.name: scavenger

ruin_stalker.description: Lean and patient. It moves between the broken walls like it owns them.
ruin_stalker.name: ruin stalker

stone_sentinel.description: A heavy figure of fitted stone. Slow, tough, relentless.
stone_sentinel.name: stone sentinel

wild_dog.description: Rangy and hungry, with a nose for Hunters.
wild_dog.name: wild dog

strangler_vine.description: A knot of creeper that tightens around anything that comes close. It doesn't move.
strangler_vine.name: strangler vine

thornback_boar.description: A boar with a ridge of thorny bristles. It charges hard.
thornback_boar.name: thornback boar

woodland_stalker.description: Hard to see among the trees until it's already close.
woodland_stalker.name: woodland stalker

glasswing.name: glasswing
glasswing.description: A moth the size of a hand, its wings gone hard and clear as windcatcher glass. It flies by night, never under a roof.

mirebellow.name: mirebellow
mirebellow.description: A bloated, slow beast that booms before it moves. The sound alone can leave a Hunter reeling, and it hits hard.

hookjaw_eel.name: hookjaw eel
hookjaw_eel.description: A pale eel that waits in cave water and lunges out across the stone at anything that comes near.

lantern_tick.name: lantern tick
lantern_tick.description: A fist-sized tick with a swollen, glowing belly. It bursts when it dies, burning whatever stands beside it. Better shot than struck.

crawler.name: crawler
crawler.description: A slow, many-legged thing armoured in plates. No deadlier than most, but it takes a beating like nothing else down here.

ashmantle.name: ashmantle
ashmantle.description: A stooped, cloaked shape that follows at a distance and leaves smouldering ash where it walks. Nothing touches it, and it touches nothing.

thistlehound.name: thistlehound
thistlehound.description: A lean, fast hound whose coat is all barbed burrs. Strike it and the burrs bite back.

hollow_elk.name: hollow elk
hollow_elk.description: A great elk with an empty ribcage and a crown of dead branches. It runs when it's losing.

gravel_wyrm.name: gravel wyrm
gravel_wyrm.description: A blind serpent that moves under the ground and surfaces to strike. Hit it while it's up: below, nothing reaches it.
